$comment: The source of sf-slider-range's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/range-slider (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/range-slider/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

page-step.summary: How far PageUp, PageDown and Shift with an arrow move a handle; ten steps when empty, as sf-input-quantity.

ticks.summary: A dot per step on the track, when there are at most twenty steps: look T1 (owner decision C80), cut out in the colour of the place the slider stands on.

scale.summary: Writes the two ends (min and max) under the track, in the slider's language and digits (C78).

marks.summary: Labels under the track at chosen values, "value:text" joined by commas ("1:плохо,3:нормально,5:отлично"); a value without text writes its number. Replaces the two ends of scale.

field.summary: The from/to field at the end of the track line (owner decision C80): one field «5 000 – 20 000 ₽» (or one number), the field height of the step; typing a number and Enter or leaving the box moves the handle, dragging rewrites the number. Hides the value at the end of the name line.

label.summary: The visible name above the slider, as every field's label (owner decision C78); it names the handles unless aria-label, aria-labelledby or lower-label/upper-label do. Until 2027-01-01 the words none, text and tooltip here still mean value-display.

value-display.summary: How the value is shown: not at all (each handle still reads it out), as text at the end of the name line, or in a bubble over the handle while it is dragged or keyboard-focused (C78). Formerly label, read until 2027-01-01.

size.summary: Size of the step, as every form field: the slider row is the control height (32 / 40 / 48, phone 28 / 36 / 44), the handle 20 / 24 / 28 (S5).

precision.summary: Digits after the decimal mark in the value shown and read out; empty takes them from `step` (0.5 has one), as sf-input-quantity. Formerly `decimals`, an alias until 2027-01-01.

grouping.summary: Group thousands the page's language's way («20 000»); `grouping="false"` writes the digits together, for a year or a code.

locale.summary: The language the value is written in; unset, the page's (`lang`), so a Russian page reads «2,5 кг».

tooltip-position.summary: Where the value bubble stands while a handle is dragged: top (default) or bottom.

text-position.summary: No effect since 1.4.0: value-display="text" writes the value at the end of the name line. Kept so old markup stays valid.

readonly.summary: Shown and not changed (owner decision C80, look R2): a read-only field's light outline at field height, a neutral handle and fill; the handles stay focusable, carry aria-readonly and are read out, keys and the pointer change nothing. The value is still submitted.

name.summary: The name the value is submitted under in a form: the handle's number, or with two handles two entries under the one name (price=5000&price=20000). Nothing while disabled.

value.summary: A number with one handle, an array of two with two.

handle.summary: Index of the handle that moved.

change.summary: A value was committed by the user (drag end, click, key); bubbles from the slider root with values, value, handleCount and handle. A value set from code is not a change. The name to bind.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: the old attribute and property write prefix-text; the property prefix is the browser's own (Element.prototype.prefix), so only the attribute is mapped
sent by the shim after change, with the same detail
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.note: sent by the shim after change, with the same detail
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-slider-range; sf-range-slider is a subclass defined beside it until the date
the old attribute writes precision, the name sf-input-quantity gives the same setting (S1); the class component still reads data-decimals until the date
label is the visible name now (C78); its three former words still set value-display, read by the element itself until the date (no shim: the attribute keeps its name, only those values move)

x-summary: A slider for one number or a range of two on a track, as a form field: a visible name above, drag, click or keys move a handle by step (PageUp/PageDown by ten), the value shown at the end of the name line, in a bubble while dragging, or in a from/to field beside the track; ticks and a scale on request; sizes 1/2, 1, 2; read-only and disabled.
x-renamed: settings.prefix → prefix-text: "prefix" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.change: 1 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
settings.min: type string with the numeral default "0" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.max: type string with the numeral default "100" → number (§16 item 29)
x-decisions: number-type: step is a number, nullable -- null is «no step», the engine's own; margin stays a string (it holds a number or nothing, and the engine reads it as given)
version: 1.1.0 -- prefix is prefix-text and sf-range-slider-change and onSliderChange follow change, behind dated aliases; a minor while they hold (§4.10)
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and the docs

css-variables: five public variables read by the class sheet src/component/range-slider/scss with the role token as fallback (§6); a state the public-variables probe cannot draw at rest (hover, an outline) takes no variable of its own yet

form (1.3.1): the host is a form control (§17.1). With `name` it submits its value -- one number, or both joined by a comma with two handles -- nothing while disabled, and a form reset puts the value it was written with back. It submitted nothing before (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 RS-03).

events.change: sent once by the host through sfEmit for a person's change, without the element in its detail (§8); the shim sends sf-range-slider-change and onSliderChange after it. A value set from code sends neither any more (§8), where sf-range-slider-change used to follow it
events sf-range-slider-update/-set/-start/-end and their onSlider* copies stay as they are, outside the interface: the class component's, read by the drag lock
host-states: none -- disabled is drawn by the template from the setting (the script no longer toggles the class)
accessibility.name: each handle is named from the host's aria-label or aria-labelledby, or in a range from lower-label and upper-label

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: the handle is a solid disc with a ring of the surface around it, and the fill ends under it (owner, 2026-11-01); hover and press draw a halo of the primary state layer, disabled is a solid disc of the disabled content role. The handle-inner-color variable is now opt-in: unset, it is transparent; a colour draws the hollow handle of 1.1. The look comes from the class sheet src/component/range-slider 1.1.0.

version 1.2.1: no ring around the handle by default, a plain disc with a soft shadow, and the inactive track loses its shadow, a flat fill (owner, 2026-11-01). The ring stays opt-in through --sf-thumb-handle--ring-width and --sf-thumb-handle--ring-color. Class sheet src/component/range-slider 1.1.1.

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-slider-range (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.slider-range and the bundle cl-slider-range follow it. sf-range-slider stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-slider-range, sf-range-slider) (change journal tag-sf-range-slider-to-sf-slider-range, path-smart-range-slider-to-slider-range).

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-11): the slider is a form control (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 RS-03). A new setting `name`; with it the host submits its value through ElementInternals -- the number, or both numbers joined by a comma with two handles -- and nothing while disabled; form.reset() puts back the value the element was written with. The values it shows are written in the page's language by the class it draws with (component.range-slider, «2,5», «20 000»; same root cause as the class fix). Nothing else is drawn differently.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-12, owner decisions C78 and C80, defects S1-S7 from the docs study control/research/2026-11-11-range-slider.md): label is the field's visible name (the handles are named by it unless aria-label, aria-labelledby or lower/upper-label do) and the former label setting is value-display none|text|tooltip -- text at the end of the name line, tooltip a bubble shown only while the handle is dragged or keyboard-focused; label="none|text|tooltip" keeps that meaning until 2027-01-01 (documentary alias, journal attribute-slider-range-c78). New: size 1/2|1|2 (row = control height of the step, handle 20/24/28), page-step (PageUp/PageDown/Shift+arrow, ten steps by default), precision (decimals is its dated alias), grouping, locale, readonly (R2: a read-only field's outline, neutral handle and fill), ticks (T1: dots in the place colour on the outline track), scale and marks (labels under the track), field (one from/to field at the end of the track line, Enter moves the handle). Values and ARIA are rounded to the step's digits; a range submits two entries under its name; the unit is held by a no-break space; disabled text takes the disabled content role; the touch target is at least the size-2 control height under a finger; the inactive track is --sf-outline (track B). Class sheet component.range-slider 1.4.0.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-slider-range to choose a number or a range of two within known bounds, where the position on a track says more than a typed number.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the host reaches each handle; with two handles lower-label and upper-label name each one. Each handle is a tab stop with a visible focus ring. Arrows move by step (mirrored in RTL), Home and End go to the handle's bounds; keyboard=false turns the keys off.

sf-range-slider-change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

component.description: The inner slider root, not the sf-slider-range host.

value.description: A number with one handle, an array of two with two.

handle.description: Index of the handle that moved.

onSliderChange.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

getSliderRoot.summary: Returns the inner slider root (.sf-range-slider), or null before render.

getValue.summary: Returns the slider's current value: a number with one handle, an array of two numbers with two; null before the slider is built.

setValue.summary: Sets the value from code (a number, a comma-separated string or an array). The handle count follows the value unless multiple is set explicitly; the value admitted by range, step and margin is reflected to the value attribute. Does not dispatch change.

setDisabled.summary: Sets or removes the disabled attribute and re-renders.

setState.summary: Applies keys: value goes through setValue, multiple fixes the handle count explicitly, disabled through setDisabled; any other key is written as its kebab-case attribute (false, null, undefined or empty removes it, true sets it empty).

onUpdateValue.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-update; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onChange.summary: Bind change, the committed value: handler(value, detail, event). Returns the element.

onSliderChange.summary: Same as onChange: listens to change, the canonical name.

onSet.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-set; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onStart.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-start; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onEnd.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-end; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.
